title: Learning to Detect: A Data-driven Approach for Network Intrusion Detection

novelty_points.claim: 针对NSL-KDD流量采用先检测入侵、再识别攻击类别的分层策略，并在攻击分类阶段结合SVM-SMOTE过采样与深度神经网络处理类别不平衡。
novelty_points.claim_en: Uses hierarchical detection on NSL-KDD traffic, first separating intrusions from normal behavior and then classifying attack types, with SVM-SMOTE oversampling and a deep neural network for imbalanced attack classes.
technical_features: 第一阶段进行正常流量与入侵流量的二分类。
第二阶段识别DoS、Probe、R2L与U2R四类攻击。
在攻击分类中使用SVM-SMOTE过采样，并以深度神经网络作为分类模型。
technical_features_en: The first stage performs binary classification of normal traffic and intrusions.
The second stage classifies anomalies into DoS, Probe, R2L, and U2R.
Uses SVM-SMOTE oversampling with a deep neural network for attack classification.
